messages.subject: a shared library problem on WIndows
parts:
Hi Guys

I have run into another ‘shared library’ problem running on windows.

I have been running nimble code previously and everything (program variants) seemed to run well

when using R4.2.

However this morning when I tried to run a variant (see below) I get a compilation error.

I had not altered any packages as far as I recall and I have RTools 4.2 installed.

 Also get the error when running on R4.1 !

I tried reinstalling nimble but this didn’t help. This may be a path problem but I am not sure.

 

Here is the code and inits:  smoothD7 is the outcome

 

x<-matrix(0,nrow=M,ncol=1)

x<-cbind(vul[,3])

P=1

COVconstsD7<-list(Csym,M,T,Sdeaths,x,Tsym,L,adj,num,P)

names(COVconstsD7)<-c("Csym","M","T","Sdeaths","x","Tsym","L","adj","num","P")

COVdataD7<-list(smoothD7)

names(COVdataD7)<-c("smoothD7")

################################################################################

#####################################################

COVModel6bD7PE<-nimbleCode({

for (i in 1:M){

asym[i,1]<-0.20*Csym[i,1]      

smoothD7[i,1]~dnorm(muc[i,1],tauy)

log(muc[i,1])<-d0+Dv[i]

}

 

for (i in 1:M){

for (j in 2:T){    

smoothD7[i,j]~dnorm(muc[i,j],tauy)

asym[i,j]<-0.20*Csym[i,j]

#log(muc[i,j])<-d0+d1*log(Csym[i,j]+asym[i,j]+0.0001)+d2*log(Csym[i,j-1]+asym[i,j-1]+0.0001)+Dv[i]+sumP[i]

log(muc[i,j])<-d0+d1*log(Csym[i,j]+asym[i,j]+0.0001)+d2*log(Tsym[i,j-1]+0.0001)+Dv[i]+sumP[i]

}}

for (i in 1:M){

Dv[i]~dnorm(0,tauDv)

for ( k in 1:P){   

abc[i,k]<-g[k]*x[i,k]}

sumP[i]<-sum(abc[i,1:P])

}

 

for(k in 1:P){

g[k]~dnorm(0,taug[k])

taug[k]~dgamma(2,0.5)}

 

#for (j in 1:T){

d1~dnorm(0,tauD1)

d2~dnorm(0,tauD2)

#}

 

for (j in 1:T){

DmucAkol[j]<-muc[2,j]

DmucMum[j]<-muc[12,j]

DmucPun[j]<-muc[26,j]

DmucThan[j]<-muc[33,j]

}

 

d0~dnorm(0,tauD0)

tauD0~dgamma(2,0.5)

tauD1~dgamma(2,0.5)

tauD2~dgamma(2,0.5)

tauDv~dgamma(2,0.5)

tauy~dgamma(2,0.5)

})

###########################################################################

COVinits6bD7PE<-list(d0=1,d1=0.1,d2=0.1,tauD0=0.1,tauD1=0.1,tauD2=0.1,

Dv=rep(0,M),tauDv=0.1,tauy=0.1,g=rep(0.1,1),taug=rep(0.1,1))

 

  ################### Run code for PE  #####################################

 

LCOVPE<-nimbleModel(code=COVModel6bD7PE,name="COVID",constants=COVconstsD7,data=COVdataD7,inits=COVinits6bD7PE)

CLCOVPE<-compileNimble(LCOVPE)

 

When I compile I get the following message:

 

Error: Failed to create the shared library. Run 'printErrors()' to see the compilation errors.

> printErrors()

P_1_COVID_nfCode.cpp: In member function 'virtual void sumP_L14_UID_14::simulate(const indexedNodeInfo&) const':

P_1_COVID_nfCode.cpp:1491:130: error: no match for 'operator-' (operand types are 'Eigen::CwiseNullaryOp<seqClass<Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, -1>, int, int, int, useBy>, Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, -1> >' and 'int')

1491 | (**model_sumP)[(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__.info[0]) - 1] = ((**model_abc)((ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__.info[0]) - 1, (nimSeqByD(1,1,1,0)) - 1)).sum();

      |                                                                                                             ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^ ~

      |                                                                                                                       |            |

      |                                                                                                                       |            int

      |                                                                                                                       Eigen::CwiseNullaryOp<seqClass<Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, -1>, int, int, int, useBy>, Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, -1> >

In file included from C:\Users\Andrew\AppData\Local\R\win-library\4.2\nimble\include/Eigen/Core:91,

                 from C:\Users\Andrew\AppData\Local\R\win-library\4.2\nimble\include/Eigen/Dense:1,

                 from C:\Users\Andrew\AppData\Local\R\win-library\4.2\nimble\include/nimble/EigenTypedefs.h:24,

 

 

The above is the top part of the error printing.

This is a strange error as previously nimble had worked on R4.2 with similar code versions /variants.

 

Any suggestions would be welcome.

 

Best

Andrew

messages.author: 35cf403e5052bfe0
messages.subject: RE: a shared library problem on WIndows
parts:
Hi again

I realized now that the error is related to the fact that I set the dimension of the x to have a single column.

When I altered the code to fix the dimension it works OK.

Thanks

Andrew

parts:
hi Andrew, glad you were able to figure it out.

Clearly we need to do a better job error trapping in this case. I can't run your code (e.g., you don't provide "M"), but if you're able to provide a fully-runnable example (please do so off-list or file an issue directly at github.com/nimble-dev/nimble), that would be great in terms of me creating an issue for us to look into this when we have a chance. 

-chris
